== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the start time and fee from the PC's US Events listing (already cited as pc-us03) and four facts from the weekend announcement (already cited as pc-mnweekend; the same text is also at [https://web.archive.org/web/20040620124316/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/mnstatesweekend04182003.htm /News/Events/2003/mnstatesweekend04182003.htm], captured 20 June 2004): open to all players under the 2003 Championship Circuit format, free championship entry for Friday sealed deck players, the pre-registration drawing (Reflections II Ultra Rare foils, Original Trilogy Special Edition DVDs) and the four Road to States Sunday tournaments at Twin City Comics.
=== Missing data ===
* The announcement does not name the individuals who carried cash bounties at the Road to States events, or the bounty amounts.
